# has time scale

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasTimeScale`](gmeow-hasTimeScale.md)

The time standard associated with a celestial reference frame. Functional: a frame uses exactly one time scale.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the time standard associated with a celestial reference frame; functional.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for civil time zones (that is [`gmeow:timezone`](gmeow-timezone.md) / a civil-time-zone overlay).

### How to use

- Set one [`gmeow:TimeScale`](../classes/gmeow-TimeScale.md) individual on the celestial frame.
